newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent up on load programme, correction to fall.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent up on load programme, correction to fall.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were slightly firmer in thin business on Tuesday in what brokers said was a slight correction to recent falls and a reaction to a Brent loading programme which was slightly below expectations.
August Brent crude was 10 cents a barrel up at 1155 GMT and stood at $17.92, while September was 14 cents up at $18.00.
August gas oil was $1 a tonne firmer at $161.75.
